message.content: {"note_claim": "Water salute (batismo com jatos de água) is a safe, common aviation tradition to celebrate special flights, performed by airport firefighters.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "It’s a time-honoured tradition at Schiphol: the water salute. In this welcoming ritual, also known as a shower of affection, two fire engines parked on either side of the runway use their water cannons to create a giant arc above a plane", "reason": "The page describes the water salute as an established tradition at Schiphol, done by fire engines to mark special occasions, with safety precautions in place."}

parsed.note_claim: Water salute (batismo com jatos de água) is a safe, common aviation tradition to celebrate special flights, performed by airport firefighters.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: It’s a time-honoured tradition at Schiphol: the water salute. In this welcoming ritual, also known as a shower of affection, two fire engines parked on either side of the runway use their water cannons to create a giant arc above a plane
parsed.reason: The page describes the water salute as an established tradition at Schiphol, done by fire engines to mark special occasions, with safety precautions in place.
